I5.quote: Nano-crystalline carbon films possessing a prevailing diamond or a graphite character, depending solely on substrate temperature and deposition time, can be deposited from a methane–hydrogen mixture by the direct current glow discharge plasma chemical vapor deposition method.

notes: Experimental study of DC glow discharge CVD nano-crystalline carbon/nanodiamond films on Si (AFM, TEM, NEXAFS, Raman). Hydrogen appears only as a CH4/H2 deposition feed gas (10 Torr), as hydrogen adsorption/desorption discussed as a growth mechanism, and as film hydrogen content by ERD (7 vs 3 at.%) cited from ref. 4; none is a measured gas-phase H2 uptake by a sorbent.
